title: Act: Add LifecycleStepper and ExecutionPanel to AdminApp
summary: Stepper, execution panel and listExecutions client call
description: Implement the stepper and panel components and render them in AdminApp using the Round status, contribution count and the execution for the Round.
acceptance_criteria: Panel shows duration from updated_at difference

steps.action: Export ExecutionInfo {id,world_id,round_id,status,error,updated_at, log?:string, tests?:string, release_version?:string} and listExecutions(token) GET /api/v1/admin/executions via adminRequest

Export STAGES=['OPEN','CLOSED','ANALYZING','DEVELOPING','TESTING','PUBLISHING','COMPLETED']; stageIndex(status) maps PLANNING->DEVELOPING and BUILDING->TESTING, else index of status, -1 otherwise; component renders <ol aria-label='Round lifecycle'> of <li data-state='done|current|pending'> with aria-current='step' on current

Export ExecutionPanel({execution,contributionCount}) rendering 'Contributions: N', 'Duration: ' computed from updated_at (or 'Not available' without execution), sections 'Agent logs', 'Test results', 'Release version' each showing the field or 'Not available', and 'Failure reason: <error>' when error is non-empty

Load listExecutions(token) and pick the one whose round_id equals roundId; render <LifecycleStepper status={round.status}/> and <ExecutionPanel execution={execution} contributionCount={contributions.length}/> below the Round header
steps.expected: Stepper and panel appear in the console
